# FreeDealCalc

> Free AI-powered real estate deal analyzer for fix-and-flip investors, wholesalers, rental buyers, and BRRRR investors. Built and operated by a 20+ year Northern Virginia investor.

FreeDealCalc is a free platform where real estate investors analyze deals in under 60 seconds using Freddie, a conversational AI analyst. No credit card. No trial. No paywall on core features. The platform covers four strategies — Fix-and-Flip, Wholesale, Rental, and BRRRR — and produces scored deal verdicts with professional AI-generated documents.

Competitors like DealCheck ($20/mo), Rehab Valuator ($29/mo), and Flipper Force ($79/mo) are calculators. FreeDealCalc is an AI analyst with document generation, built by an active investor, free at its core.

## Core Features

- Freddie AI: conversational deal intake — no forms, just a conversation
- 4 strategies covered: Fix-and-Flip, Wholesale, Rental, BRRRR
- Deal Score: 5-component scoring rubric based on 20+ years of real investor methodology
- Score Certificates: branded PDFs, unlimited free
- Seller Proposals: AI-written cash offer letters, 3/month free
- Wholesale Disposition Packages: Rentcast-verified comps, professional buyer-ready package, 3/month free
- ARV Lookups: real comp data via Rentcast API (2 lifetime free, unlimited on paid)
- Dashboard: full deal history, status tracking, pipeline management
- Deal Blast: wholesalers submit a deal, it gets pushed to a verified buyer list
- Lender Match, Agent Match, Title Company connections
- Market pages for 100 US metros with local deal analysis data
- Investor activity pages for 39 major markets
- 90+ blog posts on wholesaling, flipping, BRRRR, rental investing, and strategy

## Who It's For

Real estate wholesalers, fix-and-flip investors, BRRRR investors, rental property buyers. Beginners who want guided deal analysis. Experienced investors who want fast scoring and professional documents without paying for complex software.

## Pricing

- Free: Unlimited Freddie conversations, unlimited Score Certificates, 3 Seller Proposals/month, 3 Dispo Packages/month, 2 ARV lookups lifetime
- Investor ($19/mo): More lookups and outputs per month
- Pro ($39/mo): Unlimited outputs, white-label documents, priority features

## About the Founder

Dan White is a licensed Virginia real estate agent with Pearson Smith Realty and a 20+ year fix-and-flip investor based in Northern Virginia (Haymarket/Prince William County). FreeDealCalc is built on his personal investing methodology. Active investor on Reddit as u/Novaflips.
